description: This file defines a custom form type class 'BooleanType' that extends Symfony's CheckboxType. It customizes the rendering and options for boolean checkboxes within a form, overriding default behaviors to ensure they are always displayed according to specific styling and configuration.

classes.name: BooleanType
classes.description: A custom form type extending CheckboxType to provide specialized rendering and configuration options for boolean fields in Symfony forms.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Adds a view transformer to cast values to boolean and calls the parent buildForm method.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options like color, label position, row class, and label attributes for the form field.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Modifies the form view variables based on the options provided.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix 'boolean' for this form type, used in Twig templates.
